edges.reason: constructor assigns msg.sender to DSAuth.owner
setOwner writes the new owner address into storage
setAuthority writes the authority contract into storage
auth modifier passes msg.sender into isAuthorized
auth gate requires isAuthorized before setOwner body
auth gate requires isAuthorized before setAuthority body
authority.canCall is consulted when deciding authorization
isAuthorized performs an external call to authority.canCall
setAdminByOwner requires msg.sender to equal owner
setAdminByAdmin requires msg.sender to equal admin
setOwnerByAdmin requires msg.sender to equal admin
setAdminByOwner writes the admin address
setAdminByAdmin overwrites the admin address
setOwnerByAdmin overwrites the AdminAuth owner
kill invokes selfdestruct on the owner address
onlyOwner modifier gates kill on the owner state variable
onlyOwner modifier gates withdrawStuckFunds on the owner state variable
confirmNewMonitor compares now against changeRequestedTimestamp plus period
changeMonitor records now as the request timestamp
changeMonitor writes the request timestamp state variable
confirmNewMonitor assigns the new monitor into storage
DSProxyCache.write uses assembly create for arbitrary bytecode deployment
DSProxy.execute forwards calldata as an external call
callExecute invokes DSProxy.execute external call before reflecting state
callExecute refunds remaining balance to msg.sender
callExecute transfers leftover ETH to msg.sender, a reentrancy vector
callProxy authorizes the relayer via ecrecover of the digest
callProxy verifies the recovered signer and nonce against msg.sender supplied data
callProxy executes arbitrary calldata on the user proxy
givePermission reads the current authority from DSAuth
givePermission and removePermission both mutate guard permissions
givePermission permits execution of execute(address,bytes)
removePermission forbids execution of execute(address,bytes)
takeOrder performs a low-level call to the 0x exchange address
writeUint256 writes calldata bytes via assembly mstore
getFee branches on tx.origin bot registry membership
getFee performs uint addition and division under 0.6.6 without SafeMath
sendContractBalance transfers ETH or ERC20 to an arbitrary user supplied recipient
approveToken grants unlimited allowance to a caller supplied spender
withdrawStuckFunds is gated and funds owner derived from msg.sender during setup
